title: No near-limit acceptance-brief test for a Claude evaluator, whose brief carries the command-form paragraph
outcome: A test builds a near-limit brief through build_acceptance_evaluator_brief_for_agent for a Claude evaluator. It asserts the byte bound MAX_ACCEPTANCE_BRIEF_BYTES, that the command-form paragraph is still present, that the cuts are truthful, and the agent-dependent too-large floor. The Claude/Codex command-form assertions sit in their own test, outside src/tests/acceptance_evaluation.rs.
acceptance: No near-limit acceptance-brief test for a Claude evaluator, whose brief carries the command-form paragraph is done
